identity_conclusion.confirmed: SBIC East, Central and West are three distinct Japanese regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies, with separate legal names, establishment dates, capitals and operating regions; their official sites describe one another as sister companies.
identity_conclusion.not_sbi_holdings: These are distinct legal entities, not SBI Holdings. The shared letters 'SBI' do not establish common ownership or group affiliation.
identity_conclusion.shareholder_limitation: SBIC East's public profile lists shareholder categories, not a complete shareholder register. The reviewed pages do not establish whether SBI Holdings or any SBI Group entity has a minority shareholding; absence of a disclosed link is not proof of no relationship.
identity_conclusion.chatgpt_interpretation: The SBIC/ChatGPT reference is explained by an official SBIC East seminar. The event was organized by SBIC East, co-hosted by Hamamatsu Iwata Shinkin, and presented by a Microsoft Japan executive evangelist. It is evidence of a public educational event, not an OpenAI partnership, integration or XRP relationship.
identity_conclusion.xrp_relationship: No direct XRP, Ripple, Coinbase or Circle relationship is established by these primary SBIC profiles or seminar records.

relationship_edges.evidence: Satoshi Nishiwaki listed as Microsoft Japan executive officer and evangelist

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBIC refers to SBI Holdings or an SBI Group subsidiary.
competing_hypotheses.evidence: Official English legal names and reciprocal sister-company profiles identify three separate Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The SBIC/ChatGPT phrase indicates a commercial OpenAI partnership.
competing_hypotheses.evidence: Official event lists a Microsoft Japan speaker, ChatGPT demonstration and local shinkin co-host; no OpenAI agreement or product integration is mentioned.

limitations: The public SBIC East profile lists shareholder categories, not every shareholder name; exact beneficial ownership was not established.
No complete corporate registry extracts or shareholder registers were obtained.
No direct XRP, Ripple, Coinbase or Circle relationship was found in the reviewed SBIC primary sources.
